title: Entergy New Orleans connects with customers through community town hall meetings
summary: Entergy New Orleans recently hosted a series of community town hall meetings throughout the city, giving residents an opportunity to hear directly from our subject matter experts about electric reliability, economic development initiatives, and infrastructure projects underway in their neighborhoods. title: Bipartisan fusion bill proposes $10B for commercialization and research
summary: Ranking Member Zoe Lofgren (D., Calif.) and Rep. Jay Obernolte (R., Calif.) have led the introduction of a House bill, the American Leadership in Fusion Act. If enacted, it would provide $10 billion in direct investments for fusion facilities, research, and commercialization efforts and would authorize the establishment of an Office of Fusion within the Department of Energy and a National Science Foundation–led fusion workforce development program. The bill aims to implement the recommendations given in a bipartisan commission report released in October by the Special Competitive Studies Project’s (SCSP) Commission on the Scaling of Fusion Energy.

US Energy Department awards Entergy $13.7M to strengthen grid reliability, support the region’s growing communities
summary: The U.S. Energy Department has selected Entergy to receive $13.7 million in federal funding to improve the power delivery to Entergy’s customers and communities and support economic growth across Arkansas, Louisiana and Mississippi. The grid improvements will strengthen reliability, boost resilience and lower costs for customers. Source

title: TVA receives construction permit for Clinch River
summary: Today, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission approved the Tennessee Valley Authority’s construction permit application for its planned GE Vernova Hitachi BWRX-300 at the Clinch River site in Oak Ridge, Tenn.

NRC grants review of Homestake Mining’s groundwater ACL application
summary: The Nuclear Regulatory Commission has announced that it will begin review of Homestake Mining Company’s application to pursue alternative concentration limits (ACLs) and revised treatment options of groundwater contaminants at its Grants Reclamation Project site near Milan, N.M.

title: Entergy named a Top Utility in economic development for 19th year in a row
summary: For the 19th consecutive year, Site Selection magazine has named Entergy a Top Utility in economic development. The communities we serve continue to attract some of the nation’s most competitive and power‑intensive industries in the United States. In 2025, Entergy Mississippi helped secure $9.609 billion in capital investments and create nearly 1,177 new jobs within the Entergy Mississippi service area. Source
